summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by HSBC Holdings plc reporting poll results of its 2026 Annual General Meeting. It covers ordinary and special resolutions including election/re-election of directors, appointment of auditor, share allotment authorities, share buyback authorization, and voting on shareholder-requisitioned resolutions. No acquisition, divestiture, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation event is disclosed. The filing is a standard post-meeting report with no deal terms or structural changes.
